name: Echoes from Valeth
source:
Echoes from Valeth is an adult kinetic visual novel set in the original fictional world of Shadre.

Follow the story of Gwin Sparks, a 18 years old raccoon orphan inmersed in the most difficult period of his life. With a forgettable past without a family, an uncertain future and harassed by bullies day by day in a dense scholar ambient in the present time, he will have to fight to finally find his strenght after an unexpected event that will drastically change his life forever.

[From [url=https://aucyonproject.itch.io/echoes-from-valeth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Valeth的回响》是一部以Shadre的原创虚构世界为背景的成人动态视觉小说。

跟随格温·斯帕克斯 (Gwin Sparks) 的故事，他是一位18岁的浣熊孤儿，正处于人生最困难的时期。失去家人的难忘过去，不确定的未来，在书香浓郁的环境中日复一日地受到欺凌的骚扰，在一次彻底改变他生活的意外事件之后，他必须努力奋斗，最终找到自己的力量。

[来自[url=https://aucyonproject.itch.io/echoes-from-valeth]Itch.io[/url]]
